name: Raw | Organic King Size Cones | 3pk
description: Raw Cone Pre-Rolled Rolling Papers are perfect for people who don't know how to hand-roll. They are the ultimate convenience in rolling because you only need to fill them up with whatever you like to smoke, twist off the end and light up. 3 pack.
